hotels.name: Casa Lanterna
hotels.blurb: A restored townhouse on a stepped lane below the castle, with a tiled courtyard and a roof terrace over the river.
highlights: Breakfast in the tiled courtyard until 11:00
The 28 tram stops at the end of the street
about: A restored townhouse on a stepped lane below the castle, with 18 rooms over four floors. The upper rooms look across the rooftops of Alfama to the river. Breakfast is served in the tiled courtyard until 11:00, and guests can use the roof terrace until late. The Baixa and the riverfront are about ten minutes' walk downhill, and the 28 tram stops at the end of the street.

Rooms are simple and quiet, with tiled floors, linen bedding and wooden shutters that keep out the morning light. The courtyard has a lemon tree and a long breakfast table. The front desk is open around the clock, holds bags after check-out and can book a taxi to the airport, about 25 minutes away by road.

about: A riverside hotel on the Belém docks, built around a long outdoor pool that faces the Tagus and the 25 de Abril Bridge. Its 64 rooms are spread over five floors, and most have a view of the water or the palm garden.

The spa has a sauna, a hot tub and four treatment rooms, and the restaurant serves grilled fish and Portuguese wines on a terrace by the marina. The Jerónimos Monastery is a ten-minute walk away, and the 15 tram reaches Praça do Comércio in about 25 minutes.

about: A family-run hotel on a cobbled street in Monti, a ten-minute walk from the Colosseum. Its 16 rooms fill the second and third floors of an old ochre building, and the three tall windows over the street give the hotel its name.

Breakfast is laid out every morning in a small room off the reception: pastries from the bakery downstairs, fruit, eggs to order and proper coffee. Cavour metro station is three minutes away, and the owners keep a short list of the trattorias they eat at themselves.

hotels.name: Palazzo Lucerna
hotels.blurb: An old palazzo two streets from Piazza Navona, with 24 rooms, a courtyard restaurant and a roof terrace over the domes.
about: An old palazzo two streets from Piazza Navona, restored into 24 rooms around an arcaded courtyard. Ceilings are high and beamed, the floors are old terracotta, and the bathrooms are new marble with walk-in rain showers.

Dinner is served in the courtyard from April to October and in the vaulted cellar in winter. The roof terrace looks across the domes of the old town to St Peter's and opens for drinks at 17:00. The small spa has a sauna and two treatment rooms.

Rooms are small to mid-sized, in pale wood and linen, and the quietest face the inner courtyard. The Place des Vosges and the Picasso Museum are five minutes away on foot, and Saint-Paul metro station is around the corner.

about: Studios and apartments in three old print workshops around a cobbled yard, a minute from the Canal Saint-Martin. Each has a full kitchen, a washing machine and tall factory windows.

There's no restaurant, but a breakfast basket of bread, fruit, jam and coffee can be left at your door at 08:00. The canal's cafés and République metro station are a short walk away, and the Gare du Nord is 15 minutes on foot. Reception is staffed 08:00 to 20:00; after that you let yourself in with a door code.

Breakfast is served in the old dining room until 11:00. The roof has a small plunge pool, sun loungers and a view to the towers of the Sagrada Família. Passeig de Gràcia is five minutes away on foot, and the airport bus stops at Plaça de Catalunya, 12 minutes' walk.

about: A beach resort across the road from Bogatell beach, with 180 rooms in two low buildings around a garden. There's a family pool with a shallow end, a quieter adults' pool by the spa, and a kids' club for ages 4 to 12 every day from June to September.

Most rooms have a balcony, and the higher floors look straight out to sea. The beach restaurant serves paella and grilled fish at lunch, and the cycle path along the seafront reaches Barceloneta in about 15 minutes by bike. Poblenou metro station is a ten-minute walk.

The old stairs are steep, as in every canal house, but an elevator added at the back reaches every floor. Breakfast is served in the garden room until 10:30, bikes can be rented at the desk, and the Anne Frank House is a six-minute walk.

about: Three converted cargo houseboats moored side by side on a quiet canal in the Western Islands, a pocket of old warehouses ten minutes' walk from the Jordaan. Each has a living room with big windows at water level, a full kitchen and a bathroom with a rain shower.

The decks at the front have a table and get the evening sun. The host lives nearby, meets you on arrival, rents out bikes and can leave a breakfast basket in your kitchen. There are steep steps down into each boat, so they don't suit anyone who can't manage stairs.

The rooftop bar opens at 16:00 and fills up at sunset, so come early for a seat by the rail. Brooklyn Bridge Park is across the street, York Street subway station is four minutes away, and the walk over the Brooklyn Bridge into Manhattan takes about 30 minutes.

The spa has an indoor pool, a sauna and a hot tub, and the restaurant serves modern Mexican food with a long mezcal list. The Museo Nacional de Antropología is a 15-minute walk, and the shops and restaurants of Avenida Presidente Masaryk are around the corner.

Breakfast of msemen pancakes, eggs, fruit and mint tea is served in the courtyard or on the roof terrace, which looks across the medina to the Atlas Mountains. Jemaa el-Fna is an eight-minute walk through the souks. Cars can't reach the door, so a member of staff meets you at the nearest square and walks you in with your bags.

reviewPool.text: A fair price for a clean room in a decent area. The shower took a while to heat up.

reviewPool.name: Yuki
reviewPool.title: The kitchen was handy
reviewPool.text: We cooked twice and saved a lot. The sofa wasn't very comfortable.

reviewPool.name: Dylan
reviewPool.title: Fine, but far out
reviewPool.text: The place itself was fine. Getting to the center took longer than we expected.

reviewPool.name: Salma
reviewPool.title: The children liked the pool
reviewPool.text: The pool kept the kids happy. Breakfast got crowded after 09:00.

reviewPool.name: Martin
reviewPool.title: Comfortable and quiet
reviewPool.text: A good bed, a quiet room and decent wifi. The desk was small.

reviewPool.name: Chloe
reviewPool.title: Mixed, but fair
reviewPool.text: Lovely staff and a good bed. The bathroom needs updating.

reviewPool.name: Andrei
reviewPool.title: Easy arrival
reviewPool.text: The self check-in worked perfectly and the room was ready early.

reviewPool.name: Ming
reviewPool.title: Breakfast was good
reviewPool.text: Plenty of choice and good coffee. The room was smaller than in the photos.

reviewPool.name: Theo
reviewPool.title: Fine for the price
reviewPool.text: A basic room, but clean and well placed. Don't expect much more.

reviewPool.name: Holly
reviewPool.title: Good spot, tired room
reviewPool.text: A great base for sightseeing. The carpet and furniture have seen better days.

reviewPool.name: Vikram
reviewPool.title: Okay for one night
reviewPool.text: Handy before an early start. The room was cramped for three.

reviewPool.name: Selin
reviewPool.title: Better than I expected
reviewPool.text: For the price, the room was clean and the staff were helpful.

reviewPool.name: Bruno
reviewPool.title: Noisy at night
reviewPool.text: The walls are thin and the street is loud. Earplugs help.

reviewPool.name: Aditi
reviewPool.title: Fine for work
reviewPool.text: Wifi was reliable. Breakfast was the same every day.

reviewPool.name: Kevin
reviewPool.title: Small rooms
reviewPool.text: It's a place to sleep, not to spend time. The staff were friendly.

reviewPool.name: Esther
reviewPool.title: Handy for the trains
reviewPool.text: Close to the station, which was all I needed. Clean and simple.

reviewPool.name: Ole
reviewPool.title: Needs a refresh
reviewPool.text: The bathroom was dated and the towels were thin. The location was good.

reviewPool.name: Lina
reviewPool.title: Fine, but busy
reviewPool.text: The breakfast room was crowded every morning. Our room was quiet.

reviewPool.name: Juan
reviewPool.title: Fair value
reviewPool.text: You get what you pay for: clean sheets and a hot shower.

reviewPool.name: Akosua
reviewPool.title: Friendly and simple
reviewPool.text: The staff made up for the plain room. Good tips for dinner.

reviewPool.name: Ross
reviewPool.title: Not quite as pictured
reviewPool.text: The room was smaller and darker than the photos suggested. The staff were polite.

reviewPool.name: Mara
reviewPool.title: A disappointing breakfast
reviewPool.text: Breakfast was cold by 09:00 and nothing was refilled. The bed was fine.

reviewPool.name: Hassan
reviewPool.title: Hard to find
reviewPool.text: The entrance is easy to miss and our taxi went round twice. The room was okay.

reviewPool.name: Quinn
reviewPool.title: Okay for a night
reviewPool.text: Fine for a short stay. The air conditioning was noisy.

reviewPool.name: Ida
reviewPool.title: Noise from the bar
reviewPool.text: Music from the bar carried until late. The room itself was clean.

reviewPool.name: Tobias
reviewPool.title: Slow wifi
reviewPool.text: I couldn't hold a video call from the room. The location was handy.
